# QuizBites
> Live AI quiz tool for classrooms. Teachers create interactive quizzes in seconds — students join instantly, no app required.

## What this site does
QuizBites lets teachers create and run live interactive quizzes for their classroom using AI. Generate quiz questions on any curriculum topic in seconds, launch a live session, and students join on their phones or tablets instantly — no download, no account needed. Real-time leaderboard keeps engagement high.

## Who it's for
Primary and secondary school teachers, university lecturers, tutors, and anyone running group learning sessions. Works for any subject and any class size.

## Key features
- AI quiz generation on any curriculum topic
- Live classroom sessions with real-time leaderboard
- Students join via QR code or link — no app required
- Teacher dashboard with per-student results
- Export results as CSV or PDF
- Works on any device — phone, tablet, laptop

## Pricing
Free tier available — up to 30 students per session. Pro plan from $6.99/month for unlimited class sizes.
